items.title: 日銀總裁的「鷹派立場」未讓市場理解及接受 日元跌勢加劇
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Governor's Hawkish Stance Not Understood or Accepted by Market, Yen Decline Accelerates
paras: 日本央行總裁植田和男周五(18日)在記者會上，傳達出對於升息更為積極的鷹派姿態，然而日元不僅未能止跌，跌勢反倒進一步擴大。分析師指出，主因是植田的說法未讓投資者理解及滿意。
日本外匯市場周五傍晚，日元兌美元匯率一度跌至157區間後段，較紐約市場收盤時的跌幅達1.2%。日本央行在貨幣政策會議上將政策利率從之前的1%上調至1.25%，植田則重申繼續升息立場。

短期承壓：政策訊息混淆

Reed Capital 投資總監 Gerald Gan 表示，儘管植田試圖平息市場情緒，但他仍維持短期內日元將持續疲軟的看法，並強調日銀與美國聯準會(Fed)在前瞻指引上的分歧，正成為影響日元穩定的主要疑慮。
富國銀行(Wells Fargo)亞太區策略負責人 Chidu Narayana 指出，植田的鷹派態度不足以支持市場原本過於激進的期待，在缺乏明確鷹派信號與美元反彈下，美元兌日元匯率將維持高位。
Stonex Financial 利率主管 Shriya Samarth 認為，日銀傳遞的訊息相當混淆，既承認政策優先順序改變，又不願承諾面對通膨上行風險，難以被市場認定為足夠鷹派。T&D 資產管理首席策略師Hiroshi Namioka補充，市場難解讀植田的發言，導致日元短暫走強後再度重回貶勢。

結構性壓力與市場干預風險

Pictet Asset Management Japan 投資策略部長田中純平分析，植田宣示「政策營運階段改變」，雖有助於消除市場對日銀落後於曲線的疑慮，但受制於日元面臨的結構性下行壓力，加上市場預期的日美升息步調差異有限，僅憑本次會議結果難以觸發持續性的日元升值行情。
此外，他提醒連休期間交易清淡，投資人仍需戒備日美政府進行協調干預的可能性，預期美元兌日元將持續劇烈波動且缺乏明確方向。

部分分析師看好日元中長期走升

不過，部分分析師持較為樂觀的態度。SMBC 信託銀行投資調查部長山口真弘認為，植田成功化解了記者會可能引發日元急跌的風險，且日銀的基本立場並未改變，市場仍維持每3個月升息一次(如今年 12 月)的預期，因此不認為日元會陷入長期走貶趨勢。
State Street Investment Management 資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo強調，市場不應過度解讀兩位審議委員的反對票，美元兌日元在 160 附近仍宜採取逢高賣出策略。他預測，隨著日銀政策正常化帶動國內殖利率上升、日本資產吸引機構資金回流，以及 AI 相關投資增加等三大結構性因素，日元中長期走勢將逐漸獲得支撐。
paras_en: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda on Friday (the 18th) conveyed a more aggressive hawkish stance toward rate hikes at a press conference, yet the yen not only failed to stop falling, its decline actually widened. Analysts said the main reason was that Ueda's remarks did not resonate with or satisfy investors.

In the Japanese foreign‑exchange market on Friday evening, the yen slipped to the lower end of the 157 range against the dollar, a 1.2% drop from the New York close. The BOJ raised its policy rate from 1.0% to 1.25% at its monetary‑policy meeting, and Ueda reiterated the commitment to continue raising rates.

Short‑term pressure: mixed policy signals
Gerald Gan, Investment Director at Reed Capital, said that despite Ueda’s attempt to calm market sentiment, he still expects the yen to remain weak in the short run and highlighted the growing divergence between the BOJ and the U.S. Federal Reserve on forward guidance as a key concern for yen stability.

Chidu Narayana, Head of Asia‑Pacific Strategy at Wells Fargo, noted that Ueda’s hawkish tone was insufficient to meet the market’s overly aggressive expectations, and without a clear hawkish signal and a dollar rebound, the dollar‑yen pair is likely to stay elevated.

Shriya Samarth, Head of Rates at Stonex Financial, said the BOJ’s messaging was quite confusing – it acknowledged a shift in policy priorities but was unwilling to commit to tackling upside inflation risks, making it hard for the market to view the stance as sufficiently hawkish. Hiroshi Namioka, Chief Strategist at T&D Asset Management, added that the market struggled to interpret Ueda’s comments, causing a brief yen rally that quickly reverted to depreciation.

Structural pressure and intervention risk
Junpei Tanaka, Head of Investment Strategy for Japan at Pictet Asset Management, analyzed that Ueda’s declaration of a “change in the policy operating phase” helps allay concerns that the BOJ is lagging behind the yield curve, but the yen faces structural downward pressure and the expected gap between Japan and U.S. rate‑hiking paths is limited, so the meeting outcome alone is unlikely to trigger a sustained yen appreciation rally.

He also warned that trading is thin over the holiday period and investors should remain vigilant about the possibility of coordinated intervention by Japanese and U.S. authorities, expecting the dollar‑yen to continue swinging wildly with no clear direction.

Some analysts are bullish on the yen over the medium to long term
Nevertheless, a few analysts are more optimistic. Masahiro Yamaguchi, Head of Investment Research at SMBC Trust Bank, believes Ueda successfully defused the risk of a sharp yen drop that could have arisen from the press conference, and that the BOJ’s fundamental stance remains unchanged. The market still expects a rate hike every three months (e.g., in December), so he does not see the yen entering a long‑term downtrend.

Masahiko Loo, Senior Fixed‑Income Strategist at State Street Investment Management, stressed that the market should not over‑interpret the dissenting votes of two board members. He recommends selling on rallies near the 160 level for the dollar‑yen. He forecasts that as BOJ policy normalises, domestic yields rise, Japanese assets attract institutional inflows, and AI‑related investments grow, three structural factors will gradually support the yen’s medium‑ to long‑term trajectory.

items.title: 蕭美琴肯定藥華藥研發新藥躍上國際舞台 期盼生技業成為台灣「護體神山」
items.title_en: Vice President Hsiao Mei‑chin Affirms Yao‑Hua Pharma’s New Drug Hits International Stage, Hopes Biotech Will Become Taiwan’s “Guardian Mountain”
paras: 副總統蕭美琴今(18)日下午出席「台日美到全球 藥華藥開創世界新局－ET醫學專題演講暨感恩慶祝午宴」。蕭美琴表示，除了肯定台灣廠商自主研發新藥走向國際的重要成果外，也強調政府會做生技產業的後盾，持續完善人才培育、產業支持及國際合作環境，期盼更多生技業像藥華藥(6446-TW)一樣站上國際舞台、接軌國際，進一步擴大台灣對國際醫療及生技產業的貢獻。
蕭美琴表示，新藥開發是一條漫長而充滿挑戰的道路，從研發、臨床試驗到取得國際法規核准，需要長期投入，也要承擔高度不確定性，藥華醫藥多年來持續從臨床需求出發，累積研發與國際市場經驗，展現台灣的科研能量不僅能在臺灣落地，更能接受國際市場與法規的檢驗。
蕭美琴指出，一款新藥的背後，凝聚的是科學家的智慧、醫師與臨床團隊的努力，因此今日的成果不只是藥華醫藥的成果，也是台灣生技及醫藥產業共同努力的成果。
蕭美琴也談及過去曾至藥華醫藥位於美國波士頓南部的辦公室參訪，裡面有來自世界各國的團隊共同投入研發工作，讓他看到台灣產業透過國際合作擴大在全世界的影響力。
蕭美琴強調，許多人關注台灣引以為傲的「護國神山」，但更期待生技醫療等各領域產業，也能成為守護國人健康與身體的「護體神山」，讓世界看見台灣的能力與技術。
蕭美琴表示，台灣在人工智慧、智慧醫療等領域擁有許多新興科技，未來也將進一步改變新藥研發及醫療服務，當前國際間對於人工智慧等新興科技仍有許多討論，有人認為AI等新科技能夠帶來新發現與創新，為人類進步創造新契機，也有人認為可能衍生新的風險，但他相信，新的科技能為人類帶來進步，也為醫療帶來創新的機會。
paras_en: Vice President Hsiao Mei‑chin attended the “Taiwan‑Japan‑U.S. to the World: Yao‑Hua Pharma Creates a New Global Landscape – ET Medical Special Lecture and Thanksgiving Luncheon” this afternoon (the 18th). She praised the important achievement of Taiwanese companies independently developing new drugs for the international market and stressed that the government will back the biotech industry, continuously improving talent cultivation, industry support, and the environment for international cooperation, hoping more biotech firms will, like Yao‑Hua Pharma (6446‑TW), step onto the global stage, connect with the world, and further expand Taiwan’s contribution to international medical and biotech sectors.

Hsiao noted that new‑drug development is a long and challenging road; from R&D and clinical trials to obtaining international regulatory approval requires sustained investment and carries high uncertainty. Yao‑Hua Pharma has, over many years, started from clinical needs, accumulated R&D and international market experience, demonstrating that Taiwan’s scientific capability can not only be realized domestically but also withstand scrutiny from global markets and regulations.

She pointed out that behind every new drug lies the wisdom of scientists and the effort of physicians and clinical teams, so today’s success is not only Yao‑Hua Pharma’s achievement but also the result of collective effort by Taiwan’s biotech and pharmaceutical industry.

Hsiao also recalled a past visit to Yao‑Hua Pharma’s office in the southern Boston area, where a multinational team works together on R&D, showing her how Taiwan’s industry can expand its global influence through international collaboration.

She emphasized that many people focus on Taiwan’s proud “Guardian Mountain” of national defense, but she hopes that industries such as biotech and healthcare can also become a “Guardian Mountain” protecting the health and bodies of the nation’s people, showcasing Taiwan’s capabilities and technology to the world.

Hsiao said Taiwan possesses many emerging technologies in artificial intelligence and smart healthcare, which will further transform new‑drug development and medical services. While international debate continues over the risks and opportunities of AI and other new technologies, she believes these advances will drive human progress and bring innovative opportunities to medicine.

paras_en: Taiwan stocks surged with a massive volume rebound, seemingly optimistic, but a micro‑level chip analysis reveals that actual selling pressure has risen to a new quarterly warning high, while buying interest in chasing prices has quietly shrunk. Amid the clash of bulls and bears and rapid sector rotation, should investors keep holding or take profits? Mastering the “hit‑and‑run” rhythm is the only way to avoid risk and lock in gains during volatile waves.
Interest‑rate downside has been fully priced, boosting the rebound, yet chip signals now show a warning of price‑chasing.

Continuing the earlier program’s scenario of the Fed’s rate‑hike decision combined with a recovery from extreme pessimism, today Taiwan’s market momentum expanded further. The weighted index closed up 892.75 points, turnover rose to about NT$1.07 trillion, moving back above the monthly average volume. Leading electronics stocks such as TSMC (2330‑TW), Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and MediaTek (2454‑TW) all strengthened. After the Bank of Japan raised rates by one basis point at noon, in line with market expectations, the index was pushed even higher.

According to analyst Zhi‑Lin’s exclusive data, the number of strong stocks indeed increased and high‑level lock‑up pressure eased, so the short‑term bullish rebound framework still exists. However, micro‑level chip data is sending mixed signals: actual selling pressure has climbed to near‑quarterly highs, while genuine buyers willing to chase prices have not risen correspondingly. In other words, the rebound can continue, but it is not a cue to chase every rise.
Low‑base‑period capital is finally igniting, and wafer‑testing has become the clearest driver of the market’s catch‑up rally.

Yesterday the analyst already set the market tone, naming semiconductor wafer‑testing as the group with the strongest low‑base catch‑up conditions. Today the market validated that view: ASE Technology (3711‑TW) and Qibao (6147‑TW) both surged, while tracked stocks KYE Systems (2449‑TW) and Siliconware (6257‑TW) each hit their daily limits on volume. This exemplifies the core principle of left‑side trading: you do not wait for a stock to skyrocket before finding a reason, but rather do the homework and patiently wait for capital rotation when low‑level price, chip and industry fundamentals are forming. AI high‑speed transmission standards are also attracting capital, showing that money is moving from heavyweight stocks to electronic sub‑sectors with upgraded specs and low‑base conditions. The timing is gradually entering the month‑before‑TSMC’s quarterly earnings‑call positioning stage, with semiconductor equipment and factory‑service supply chains showing warming trends. Fanxuan (6196‑TW) continues to raise its bottom pattern; the key observation going forward is not today’s price gain but whether volume can break through the large block of locked‑up chips ahead. Only when the volume‑price structure breaks will a new wave‑trading phase become possible.

items.title_en: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger: Global Wafer Foundries Cannot Rely 95% on a Single Supplier, CPU Demand Can Only Meet Half of Customers
paras: 在科羅拉多州丹佛舉行的 Splunk「.conf26」大會上，思科(CSCO-US)總裁兼首席產品官 Jeetu Patel 與英特爾(INTC-US)執行長陳立武展開了一場深度的爐邊對談。陳立武不僅首度詳述自己臨危受命接掌英特爾的內部改革歷程，更明確指出半導體產業已從單純「搶購 GPU」轉變為涵蓋 CPU、先進封裝與系統軟體的「系統級競爭」。
此外，陳立武對全球半導體製造高度集中於單一台灣晶圓代工業者的風險發出警訊，並公布英特爾在先進製程 18A、14A 及先進封裝 EMIB 技術上的最新戰略突破。

臨危受命重構英特爾：經營問題比想像嚴重大十倍

陳立武回顧，自己早年畢業於核子工程專業，長久以來將英特爾視為半導體標竿，並曾擔任英特爾董事會成員。然而，當他獲邀出任執行長掌舵時，多位好友甚至其妻子都曾極力勸阻。他坦言，真正深入營運第一線後才發現，內部問題的嚴峻程度與複雜性比在董事會席位上看到的「嚴重大十倍以上」。
面對沉重挑戰，陳立武推動了多項關鍵變革：第一，重塑問責文化與講真話的風氣，摒棄粉飾太平的彙報
；第二，保持謙遜並深入傾聽客戶需求，甚至手記大客戶列出的 15 項缺失並逐一解決；第三，實施扁平化的工程團隊彙報機制，直接掌握技術進展。
同時，他展現「示弱」與開放合作的態度，提到輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳曾半開玩笑地表示願意投資 50 億美元協助英特爾。陳立武透露，自己接手時英特爾市值約為 900 億美元，如今已提升至約 5,000 億美元，但未來的十年仍將是一場硬仗。

AI 競賽邁向「系統級競爭」：CPU 產能缺口達 50%

隨著推理型 AI Agent(智慧體)呈現爆發式成長，陳立武強調，AI 基礎設施的競爭正從過去的「搶 GPU」擴大為「GPU＋CPU＋高頻寬記憶體(HBM)＋網路＋儲存＋先進封裝＋晶圓產能」的系統級全方位較量。
陳立武指出，雖然 GPU 擅長模型訓練，但 CPU 在工作流編排、控制邏輯及單執行緒運作上具有不可替代的關鍵作用。目前市場對英特爾核心產品 CPU 的需求極為強勁，產能「僅能滿足約 50% 的客戶需求」，許多科技巨頭執行長紛紛致電催貨。
展望未來，預計將有數以萬億計的 AI Agent 上線運作，這不僅需要龐大的運算能力支撐，更需要從矽片端到平台系統層級建構嚴密的端點安全防線與護欄。

警惕 95% 單一供應鏈風險：EMIB 先進封裝挑戰台積電 CoWoS

在半導體供應鏈安全議題上，陳立武發表了最具影響力的論述。他指出：「95% 依賴一家公司，尤其是總部位於台灣的公司，是非常危險的。」
此言論指向全球最先進晶片製造過度集中於單一供應商所帶來的風險，並符合美國推動先進封裝與先進製程產能在地化的政策方向。
陳立武強調，晶圓代工本質上是「客戶服務業」，經營晶圓廠必須極為精細地管控良率(Yield)、缺陷率(Defects)、生產週期(Cycle Time)與製造波動性(Variability)。
針對系統化整合，英特爾全力推廣其 EMIB(嵌入式多晶片互連橋接)先進封裝技術，透過矽橋連結多個晶片，作為對標台積電 CoWoS 封裝的戰略武器。儘管載板(Substrates)供應仍由少數日台廠商掌控形成挑戰，英特爾已延攬前 SK 海力士執行長李錫熙統籌後段先進封裝營運，並改善外部合作透明度，使過去 18 個月良率年均提升約 7%。

先進製程突破與未來前瞻：14A 攜手 Terafab 押注突破功耗牆

在製程推進方面，陳立武透露 Intel 18A 製程節點已全面進入量產階段，而 Intel 14A 製程則預計於明年第一季正式投產。其中，由特斯拉(TSLA-US)與 SpaceX 帶領的 Terafab 項目已成為 Intel 14A 的首家客戶，其首款產品預計於 2028 年年中正式下線。
針對未來技術布局，陳立武警告全產業正撞上「功耗牆」，因此英特爾正逆向押注類腦神經擬態運算(Neuromorphic)、存算一體架構以及 CPU 與記憶體的深度融合，力求大幅降低能耗。在量子運算領域，他預測未來 3 至 5 年內量子運算將以混合算力的形式帶來實質影響。
最後，陳立武引用其早年在麻省理工學院(MIT)經歷三哩島核事故的往事，呼籲產業領導者建立積極的 AI 敘事，切勿讓恐慌情緒扼殺具有顛覆性價值的產業發展。
paras_en: At Splunk ".conf26" conference in Denver, Colorado, Cisco (CSCO-US) President and Chief Product Officer Jeetu Patel sat down for an in‑depth fireside chat with Intel (INTC-US) CEO Pat Gelsinger. Gelsinger not only detailed for the first time his emergency takeover of Intel’s internal reform, but also clarified that the semiconductor industry has shifted from a pure "GPU rush" to a system‑level competition that includes CPUs, advanced packaging and system software.

He also warned of the risk of the global semiconductor manufacturing base being overly concentrated in a single Taiwanese wafer‑foundry and announced Intel’s latest strategic breakthroughs in advanced process nodes 18A, 14A and the EMIB advanced‑packaging technology.

Rebuilding Intel under fire: operational problems are ten times worse than imagined. Gelsinger recalled that he graduated in nuclear engineering, long regarded Intel as the industry benchmark, and once served on Intel’s board. When he was asked to become CEO, many friends and even his wife urged him not to. He admits that once he got into day‑to‑day operations he discovered the severity and complexity of internal issues were more than ten times what he saw from the board seat.
Facing the heavy challenge, Gelsinger drove several key changes: first, reshaping a culture of accountability and candor, discarding any sugar‑coated reporting.

Second, staying humble and listening deeply to customer needs, even documenting the 15 shortcomings listed by major customers and fixing them one by one; third, implementing a flat engineering reporting structure to directly track technical progress.

He also showed a "show‑weakness" and open‑collaboration stance, noting that Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang half‑jokingly said he would invest $5 billion to help Intel. Gelsinger said Intel’s market cap was about $90 billion when he took over and is now roughly $500 billion, but the next decade will still be a hard fight.

AI competition is moving to "system‑level competition": CPU capacity gap reaches 50%. As inference‑type AI agents explode, Gelsinger stressed that AI infrastructure competition has expanded from a "GPU rush" to a full‑stack battle involving GPU, CPU, high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), networking, storage, advanced packaging and wafer capacity.

He pointed out that while GPUs excel at model training, CPUs are irreplaceable for workflow orchestration, control logic and single‑threaded workloads. Current demand for Intel’s core CPU products is extremely strong, with capacity able to satisfy only about 50% of customer demand, prompting many tech‑company CEOs to call and push for shipments.
Looking ahead, tens of trillions of AI agents are expected to go live, requiring massive compute power and a tightly integrated security perimeter from silicon to platform level.

Beware of 95% single‑supplier risk: EMIB advanced packaging challenges TSMC CoWoS. On supply‑chain security, Gelsinger delivered his most impactful statement, saying "Relying 95% on one company, especially one headquartered in Taiwan, is very dangerous."

The comment highlights the risk of the world’s most advanced chip manufacturing being overly concentrated in a single supplier, aligning with U.S. policy to localize advanced‑process and advanced‑packaging capacity.
Gelsinger emphasized that wafer foundries are essentially a "customer service business" and must tightly control yield, defect rates, cycle time and manufacturing variability.

For system integration, Intel is pushing its EMIB (Embedded Multi‑Die Interconnect Bridge) advanced‑packaging technology, which links multiple chips via silicon bridges as a strategic counter to TSMC’s CoWoS. Although substrate supply remains controlled by a few Japan‑Taiwan firms, Intel has hired former SK Hynix CEO Lee Seok‑hee to oversee back‑end advanced‑packaging operations, improving transparency and raising annual yield by about 7% over the past 18 months.

Advanced‑process breakthroughs and future outlook: 14A teams with Terafab to break the power wall. Gelsinger disclosed that Intel’s 18A node is now in full‑scale production, while the 14A node is slated for volume production in Q1 2025. The Terafab project, led by Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX, is Intel’s first 14A customer, with its first product expected to ship in mid‑2028.

Looking forward, Gelsinger warned the industry is hitting a "power wall" and Intel is betting on neuromorphic computing, compute‑in‑memory architectures and deep CPU‑memory integration to slash energy use. In quantum computing, he predicts that within three to five years quantum workloads will make a tangible impact through hybrid compute models.

Finally, Gelsinger recalled his early experience at MIT during the Three‑Mile Island nuclear incident, urging industry leaders to craft a proactive AI narrative and not let fear stifle disruptive value creation.

items.title: AI三巨頭齊喊煞車 緯創林憲銘、和碩童子賢仍樂觀看AI產業
items.title_en: AI Giants Call for a Brake, Yet Wistron Chairman Lin Hsien-Ming and Pegatron Chairman Tong Tzu-Hsien Remain Optimistic About the AI Industry
paras: 近日AI三巨頭Anthropic執行長阿莫戴、OpenAI執行長奧特曼及特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克相繼呼籲，放緩AI開發腳步。對此，緯創(3231-TW)董事長林憲銘以及和碩(4938-TW)董事長童子賢今(18)日雙雙指出，持續樂觀看待AI產業。
林憲銘表示，以現階段觀察，緯創自身訂單都沒有變化，整體需求還是相當暢旺，且產能仍維持高檔，對於AI產業前景仍持樂觀看法。
不過林憲銘也點出，除了AI三巨頭同步呼籲應放緩AI開發腳步，還需觀察美國在地社群對於建置資料中心的反對聲音，特別是美國適逢期中選舉，要特別注意是否會變成爭取選票的議題。
林憲銘進一步提到，當企業面臨產業、需求轉變，需要進行策略調整時，必須在衝刺與踩剎車之間取得平衡，如在規劃資本支出，需將風險納入考量，在風險來臨前，要做好資金、營運架構等相關規劃，當風暴來臨時才能順利度過。
林憲銘強調，產業發展過程碰到困難在所難免，無論技術上、社會上或是環境上都有可能面臨挑戰，但相信這些困難都能一一解決，因此仍樂觀看待整個產業。
童子賢則指出，AI三巨頭近期因安全性問題，呼籲應放緩AI開發速度，但他以「3部跑車要飆車」形容，認為這可能是各自要在競爭中取得優勢，因此一邊飆車、一邊喊煞車。整體而言，童子賢還是很看好AI產業，並認為AI未來還是可以兼顧安全性與效率。
paras_en: Recently, the three AI giants—Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk—have each urged a slowdown in AI development. In response, Wistron (3231-TW) Chairman Lin Hsien-Ming and Pegatron (4938-TW) Chairman Tong Tzu-Hsian both said today (the 18th) that they remain optimistic about the AI sector.

Lin Hsien-Ming said that, based on current observations, Wistron’s own orders have not changed, overall demand remains robust, and capacity is still operating at a high level, so he stays positive about the AI industry's outlook.

However, Lin also noted that beyond the AI giants’ joint call to slow development, one must watch the opposition from local U.S. communities to building data centers, especially as the United States heads into its midterm elections, which could turn the issue into a political vote‑seeking topic.

Lin further explained that when companies face industry or demand shifts and need to adjust strategy, they must balance acceleration with braking—such as incorporating risk considerations into capital‑expenditure planning and preparing financing and operational structures in advance so they can weather a storm when it arrives.

He emphasized that encountering difficulties is inevitable in industry development—whether technical, social, or environmental—but believes these challenges can be resolved one by one, maintaining a hopeful view of the sector.

Tong Tzu-Hsian pointed out that the AI giants recently called for a slowdown due to safety concerns, but he likened it to “three sports cars wanting to race,” suggesting each is trying to gain a competitive edge while simultaneously calling for brakes. Overall, Tong remains very bullish on AI, believing the technology can still balance safety and efficiency in the future.

items.title: 升息為何讓日元重摔、日股大漲？解析日銀決策被解讀不夠鷹派的三大關鍵
paras: 日本銀行(央行，BOJ)周五(18日)將升息1碼(25個基點)至1.25%，利率創1995年以來最高，且升息間隔從之前的六個月縮短為三個月。儘管升息步調加快，日本金融市場卻出現違反直覺的走勢：日元走弱、10年期日本公債殖利率下滑，日經225指數上漲。
分析師指出，日銀理事會表決出現兩張反對升息票，加上本次升息並未同步公布最新經濟展望，都讓市場解讀日銀不夠鷹派。
目前市場預期，日銀可能在12月左右再次升息，但對利率最終將升至多高卻看法不一。
升息通常會帶動一國貨幣上揚、推升債券殖利率，並對股市造成壓力，但日本的貨幣、債券殖利率與股市周五卻出現完全相反的走勢。截稿前，日元跌破157日元兌1美元，10年期日本政府公債殖利率下滑，日經225指數收盤上漲1.4%。

升息決策7票對2票 市場解讀不夠鷹派

專家指出，日銀理事會出現分歧，是市場出現非典型反應的原因，因為這顯示日本央行可能不會採取過於鷹派的立場。
日本銀行三井住友銀行(SMBC)首席外匯策略師Hirofumi Suzuki說：「兩票反對升息、主張維持利率不變，令人感到意外。」
本次升息決策以七票對兩票通過，理事淺田統一郎(Toichiro Asada)與佐藤綾野(Ayano Sato)投下反對票，他們是由首相高市早苗今年稍早任命、被視為恢復通膨派的人馬。
佐藤綾野指出，由於核心通膨率低於2%，經濟情勢可能還不夠強勁，因此主張維持利率不變。日本8月核心通膨率微降至1.7%，低於7月的1.8%。
淺田統一郎也表示，與先前相比，目前經濟與物價發展似乎沒有大幅加速。

未同步更新經濟展望

道富投資管理公司(State Street Investment Management)資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo指出，此次升息未同步公布更新版的經濟展望報告，也是市場反直覺回應的原因之一，因為這限制了日銀透過調整預測來強化鷹派訊息的能力。
牛津經濟學(Oxford Economics)日本經濟主管Shigeto Nagai認同這項看法，他表示，兩名反對升息的理事傳遞的訊號是，高市早苗並未確定接受美國要求日本加快升息的主張。
路透周五報導，美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)5月與日本財務大臣片山皋月(Satsuki Katayama)會面時，曾強調日銀需要提高利率。
Nagai進一步補充說：「其次，如果我們觀察聲明，所有措辭與語氣幾乎都與7月公布的季度展望報告相同，因此語氣不像金融市場原本期待的那麼鷹派。」

利率還能升多少？

專家目前認為，日銀可能在12月左右再次升息。
道富的Loo表示，他預期日銀總裁植田和男將強調，未來每一次政策會議都仍然「有可能升息」。他說：「如今爭論的已經不是日銀是否升息，而是利率最終會升到多高。」
日銀表示，隨著經濟與物價情勢發展，將持續調升利率。不過，日銀也承認，中東衝突推升油價，可能導致經濟成長放緩。
EFG International經濟學家Sam Jochim表示，隨著潛在通膨率接近2%，利率可能大約每三個月調升一次。他預期，2027年的終點利率、也就是利率可能達到的峰值，將落在1.75%至2%之間。
BOJ並未預測終點利率，而是持續表示將「適當」執行貨幣政策，以讓潛在通膨率穩定在約2%的目標。
穆迪分析(Moody’s Analytics)亞太區經濟主管Stefan Angrick預期，日銀可能在今年底至明年初再度升息，但需求帶動的通膨疲弱，加上實質薪資成長令人失望，將限縮後續的升息幅度。

items.title: 外資期現貨用力做多 買超869億元史上第5大 全周仍賣超184億元
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Take Strong Long Positions in Futures and Spot, Buying Over 86.99 Billion TWD, the Fifth Largest on Record, While Still Selling 18.46 Billion TWD for the Week
paras: 台北股市今 (18) 日在各不確定性消除之後，大盤終場以上漲892.75點收盤，報47180.75點，成交值逾1.07兆元，龐大量能潮補足昨日未能站穩4700點遺憾。外資在期貨、現貨同步做多，買超869.94億元創台股中第5大買超，加碼個股以記憶體族群爲主。儘管外資連續2日買超共991.79億元，全周仍賣超184.64億元。
今天外資買超的的記憶體族群重要個股包括，力積電(6770-TW)、華邦電(2344-TW)、南亞科(2408-TW)、旺宏(2337-TW)，今天外資買超力積電77685張，對華邦電由賣轉在今天買超42774張，外資對旺宏也是由賣轉買，外資今天買超旺宏9853張。外資今天買超南亞科32233張。
在台北匯市方面，9月18日新台幣兌美元匯率以31.808元作收、升值7.3分，成交金額30.4億美元。上午新台幣以31.860元開出，盤中最高31.722元，最低31.860元；本週貶0.54%。
今天三大法人買超1165.86億元，外資買超869.94億元，投信買超52.89億元，自營商買超243.03億元；同時外資在期貨市場，交易口數淨額爲多單2521口，未平倉淨額爲空單75110口。
今天外資在集中市場買超較多的個股爲，力積電、華邦電、南亞科、聯電、京元電子、南茂、矽格、旺宏、元大金；賣超較多的個股爲，友達、臺企銀、群創、玉山金、和益、彰銀、長榮航、南亞、益航、藥華藥。
今天投信在集中市場買超較多的個股爲，聯電、長榮航、藥華藥、廣達、興富發、南亞科、力積電、友達、緯創、寶成；賣超較多的個股爲，國泰金、元大金、兆豐金、華南金、力成、台新新光金、世芯-KY、富邦金、遠東新、合庫金。
今天自營商在集中市場買超較多的個股爲，力積電、聯電、華邦電、友達、益航、京元電、南茂；賣超較多的個股爲，群創、光鼎、聯嘉投控、皇普、可寧衛、億光、臻鼎-KY、致伸、台勝科、中華化。
對今天台股的盤勢，資深證券分析師簡伯儀指出，OTC更強大甚於集中市場走勢，台股量能逐日放大，目前在各項不確定因素排除後，接下來將再觀察季底的法人作帳行情，在5日線未遭跌破之前，投資人對台股仍是以偏多操作爲主。
paras_en: Taipei's stock market closed higher by 892.75 points at 47,180.75 on the 18th, after uncertainties were cleared, with a trading value exceeding 1.07 trillion TWD, making up for yesterday's failure to hold above 4,700 points. Foreign investors simultaneously went long in futures and spot, buying a net 86.994 billion TWD, the fifth largest buy‑over‑sell in Taiwan's market, mainly adding to memory‑chip stocks. Despite a cumulative net buy of 99.179 billion TWD over two consecutive days, the week still saw a net sell of 184.64 billion TWD.

The memory‑chip stocks that foreign investors bought today included Powerchip (6770‑TW), Wistron (2344‑TW), Nanya Technology (2408‑TW), and Macronix (2337‑TW). Foreign investors bought 77,685 lots of Powerchip, switched from selling to buying 42,774 lots of Wistron, and also switched from selling to buying 9,853 lots of Macronix. They bought 32,233 lots of Nanya Technology.

In the Taipei foreign exchange market, the New Taiwan dollar traded at 31.808 per U.S. dollar at close, appreciating 0.73 cents, with a turnover of 3.04 billion USD. The dollar opened at 31.860, peaked at 31.722, and fell to 31.860 during the day; the week saw a depreciation of 0.54%.

items.title: 通用型醫學影像AI模型登上《Science》正刊並已開源 阿里巴巴合作研發
items.title_en: General-Purpose Medical Imaging AI Model Published in Science and Open-Source, Developed with Alibaba
paras: 由阿里巴巴達摩院與浙江大學醫學院附屬第一醫院等機構聯合研發的「DAMO RADAR」模型，於2026年9月發表於國際學術期刊《科學》(Science)正刊。該模型為針對腹部對比增強電腦斷層掃描(CT)所設計的通用型視覺-語言模型，能單次識別腹部18種解剖結構及146種病症，目前已完整開源。

技術架構與訓練機制

腹部CT掃描涉及消化、泌尿及生殖等多個器官系統，器官組織密度相近且病灶較分散。傳統醫療影像AI多採監督式學習，依賴大量手動標註，導致開發成本高且僅能應對單一疾病。
達摩院高級演算法專家張建鵬指出，專病模型開發週期長達二至三年，難以逐一涵蓋成千上萬種疾病；且直接套用傳統視覺-語言對齊方法，易使微小病灶信號被正常組織淹沒。為解決此問題，DAMO RADAR導入「器官級細粒度對齊」與自適應對比建模，模擬放射科醫師按器官排查的讀片邏輯，直接從影像與臨床報告的對應關係中學習，無需額外手動標註。

臨床驗證與協同效益

研究團隊進行了多中心臨床驗證：在近3.9萬例內部連續隊列中，DAMO RADAR的受試者工作特徵曲線下面積(AUC)達0.913；在8家外部醫療中心(逾2.4萬例)驗證中，AUC介於0.874至0.912。針對肝癌、胰臟癌、胃癌及大腸直腸癌等四種癌症的病理金標準評估，AUC達0.891至0.984。
此外，在2.7萬例未經專門訓練的急診CT測試中，模型AUC亦達0.904。
在包含14家醫院共26位放射科醫師的測試中，DAMO RADAR的獨立診斷準確率超越其中23位醫師。人機協同實驗顯示，AI輔助可將醫師的診斷敏感度提升約10%，平均閱片時間縮短30%以上。

專家觀點與未來應用

浙大一院放射科主任肖文波指出，腹部CT具備「同病異影、異病同影」的複雜性，醫師處理單例報告需耗時約20分鐘，AI能輔助降低良惡性判別時的漏診風險。針對年輕醫師可能產生技術依賴的疑慮，肖文波建議將RADAR作為「一對一帶教工具」，由醫師先獨立撰寫報告再透過AI自我檢測與交叉驗證。
達摩院資深演算法專家張靈表示，《Science》過去鮮少刊登醫學影像AI論文，RADAR通過嚴格審查，證實通用型醫學影像AI是一條具現實可行性的科學技術路線。

AI 教父 Geoffrey Hinton在 2016 年曾斷言「人們現在就應該停止培養放射科醫師」，並預測 5 年內 AI 在醫療影像識別上就會超越放射科醫師。十年過去後，放射科醫師非但沒有消失，人數反而增加。如黃仁勳所言，如今幾乎每一位放射科醫師都在以某種方式使用 AI 作為輔助。像 DAMO RADAR 這類新型通用影像模型，其定位也是作為醫師的「閱片助手」與帶教工具，協助降低漏診率與節省阅片時間，而非取代醫師。
paras_en: The "DAMO RADAR" model, jointly developed by Alibaba DAMO Academy, Zhejiang University School of Medicine Affiliated First Hospital, and other institutions, was published in the September 2026 issue of the international academic journal Science. This model is a general-purpose vision-language model designed for abdominal contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) scans, capable of identifying 18 abdominal anatomical structures and 146 diseases in a single pass, and it has been fully open-sourced.

The technical architecture and training mechanism: abdominal CT scans involve multiple organ systems such as digestive, urinary, and reproductive, with tissues of similar density and dispersed lesions. Traditional medical imaging AI largely relies on supervised learning, dependent on extensive manual annotations, leading to high development costs and limited to single diseases.

Senior algorithm expert Zhang Jianpeng of DAMO Academy noted that disease-specific model development cycles can take two to three years, making it impossible to cover thousands of diseases one by one; moreover, directly applying conventional vision-language alignment methods can cause subtle lesion signals to be drowned out by normal tissue. To address this, DAMO RADAR introduces "organ-level fine-grained alignment" and adaptive contrast modeling, simulating how radiologists read images by organ, learning directly from the correspondence between images and clinical reports without additional manual labeling.

Clinical validation and collaborative benefits: the research team conducted multi-center clinical validation. In an internal continuous cohort of nearly 39,000 cases, DAMO RADAR achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.913; in external validation across eight medical centers (over 24,000 cases), the AUC ranged from 0.874 to 0.912. For four cancers—liver, pancreatic, gastric, and colorectal—the pathological gold standard assessment yielded AUCs between 0.891 and 0.984.
Additionally, in 27,000 emergency CT cases that were not specifically trained, the model also achieved an AUC of 0.904.

In a test involving 14 hospitals and 26 radiologists, DAMO RADAR’s independent diagnostic accuracy surpassed that of 23 of the radiologists. Human-machine collaboration experiments showed that AI assistance could increase radiologists’ diagnostic sensitivity by about 10% and reduce average reading time by more than 30%.

Expert opinions and future applications: Dr. Xiao Wenbo, head of radiology at Zhejiang University First Hospital, pointed out that abdominal CT has the complexity of "same disease, different imaging" and "different disease, same imaging". Radiologists spend about 20 minutes on a single report, and AI can help reduce missed diagnoses when distinguishing benign from malignant. Addressing concerns that young radiologists might become overly dependent on technology, Xiao suggested using RADAR as a "one-to-one teaching tool", where radiologists first write reports independently and then use AI for self-check and cross-validation.

Senior algorithm expert Zhang Ling stated that Science rarely publishes medical imaging AI papers; RADAR passed rigorous review, proving that general-purpose medical imaging AI is a scientifically viable and practical technology path.

AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton in 2016 once declared that "people should stop training radiologists now" and predicted that within five years AI would surpass radiologists in medical image recognition. Ten years later, radiologists have not disappeared; their numbers have even increased. As Jensen Huang notes, almost every radiologist now uses AI in some form. Models like DAMO RADAR are positioned as "reading assistants" and teaching tools for radiologists, helping reduce missed diagnoses and save reading time, rather than replacing them.

items.title: 蕭美琴肯定藥華藥研發新藥躍上國際舞台 期盼生技業成為台灣「護體神山」
items.title_en: Vice President Hsiao Mei‑chin Affirms Yao‑Hua Pharma’s New Drug Hits International Stage, Hopes Biotech Will Become Taiwan’s “Guardian Mountain”
paras: 副總統蕭美琴今(18)日下午出席「台日美到全球 藥華藥開創世界新局－ET醫學專題演講暨感恩慶祝午宴」。蕭美琴表示，除了肯定台灣廠商自主研發新藥走向國際的重要成果外，也強調政府會做生技產業的後盾，持續完善人才培育、產業支持及國際合作環境，期盼更多生技業像藥華藥(6446-TW)一樣站上國際舞台、接軌國際，進一步擴大台灣對國際醫療及生技產業的貢獻。
蕭美琴表示，新藥開發是一條漫長而充滿挑戰的道路，從研發、臨床試驗到取得國際法規核准，需要長期投入，也要承擔高度不確定性，藥華醫藥多年來持續從臨床需求出發，累積研發與國際市場經驗，展現台灣的科研能量不僅能在臺灣落地，更能接受國際市場與法規的檢驗。
蕭美琴指出，一款新藥的背後，凝聚的是科學家的智慧、醫師與臨床團隊的努力，因此今日的成果不只是藥華醫藥的成果，也是台灣生技及醫藥產業共同努力的成果。
蕭美琴也談及過去曾至藥華醫藥位於美國波士頓南部的辦公室參訪，裡面有來自世界各國的團隊共同投入研發工作，讓他看到台灣產業透過國際合作擴大在全世界的影響力。
蕭美琴強調，許多人關注台灣引以為傲的「護國神山」，但更期待生技醫療等各領域產業，也能成為守護國人健康與身體的「護體神山」，讓世界看見台灣的能力與技術。
蕭美琴表示，台灣在人工智慧、智慧醫療等領域擁有許多新興科技，未來也將進一步改變新藥研發及醫療服務，當前國際間對於人工智慧等新興科技仍有許多討論，有人認為AI等新科技能夠帶來新發現與創新，為人類進步創造新契機，也有人認為可能衍生新的風險，但他相信，新的科技能為人類帶來進步，也為醫療帶來創新的機會。
paras_en: Vice President Hsiao Mei‑chin attended the “Taiwan‑Japan‑U.S. to the World: Yao‑Hua Pharma Creates a New Global Landscape – ET Medical Special Lecture and Thanksgiving Luncheon” this afternoon (the 18th). She praised the important achievement of Taiwanese companies independently developing new drugs for the international market and stressed that the government will back the biotech industry, continuously improving talent cultivation, industry support, and the environment for international cooperation, hoping more biotech firms will, like Yao‑Hua Pharma (6446‑TW), step onto the global stage, connect with the world, and further expand Taiwan’s contribution to international medical and biotech sectors.

Hsiao noted that new‑drug development is a long and challenging road; from R&D and clinical trials to obtaining international regulatory approval requires sustained investment and carries high uncertainty. Yao‑Hua Pharma has, over many years, started from clinical needs, accumulated R&D and international market experience, demonstrating that Taiwan’s scientific capability can not only be realized domestically but also withstand scrutiny from global markets and regulations.

She pointed out that behind every new drug lies the wisdom of scientists and the effort of physicians and clinical teams, so today’s success is not only Yao‑Hua Pharma’s achievement but also the result of collective effort by Taiwan’s biotech and pharmaceutical industry.

Hsiao also recalled a past visit to Yao‑Hua Pharma’s office in the southern Boston area, where a multinational team works together on R&D, showing her how Taiwan’s industry can expand its global influence through international collaboration.

She emphasized that many people focus on Taiwan’s proud “Guardian Mountain” of national defense, but she hopes that industries such as biotech and healthcare can also become a “Guardian Mountain” protecting the health and bodies of the nation’s people, showcasing Taiwan’s capabilities and technology to the world.

Hsiao said Taiwan possesses many emerging technologies in artificial intelligence and smart healthcare, which will further transform new‑drug development and medical services. While international debate continues over the risks and opportunities of AI and other new technologies, she believes these advances will drive human progress and bring innovative opportunities to medicine.

items.title: AI三巨頭齊喊煞車 緯創林憲銘、和碩童子賢仍樂觀看AI產業
items.title_en: AI Giants Call for a Brake, Yet Wistron Chairman Lin Hsien-Ming and Pegatron Chairman Tong Tzu-Hsien Remain Optimistic About the AI Industry
paras: 近日AI三巨頭Anthropic執行長阿莫戴、OpenAI執行長奧特曼及特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克相繼呼籲，放緩AI開發腳步。對此，緯創(3231-TW)董事長林憲銘以及和碩(4938-TW)董事長童子賢今(18)日雙雙指出，持續樂觀看待AI產業。
林憲銘表示，以現階段觀察，緯創自身訂單都沒有變化，整體需求還是相當暢旺，且產能仍維持高檔，對於AI產業前景仍持樂觀看法。
不過林憲銘也點出，除了AI三巨頭同步呼籲應放緩AI開發腳步，還需觀察美國在地社群對於建置資料中心的反對聲音，特別是美國適逢期中選舉，要特別注意是否會變成爭取選票的議題。
林憲銘進一步提到，當企業面臨產業、需求轉變，需要進行策略調整時，必須在衝刺與踩剎車之間取得平衡，如在規劃資本支出，需將風險納入考量，在風險來臨前，要做好資金、營運架構等相關規劃，當風暴來臨時才能順利度過。
林憲銘強調，產業發展過程碰到困難在所難免，無論技術上、社會上或是環境上都有可能面臨挑戰，但相信這些困難都能一一解決，因此仍樂觀看待整個產業。
童子賢則指出，AI三巨頭近期因安全性問題，呼籲應放緩AI開發速度，但他以「3部跑車要飆車」形容，認為這可能是各自要在競爭中取得優勢，因此一邊飆車、一邊喊煞車。整體而言，童子賢還是很看好AI產業，並認為AI未來還是可以兼顧安全性與效率。
paras_en: Recently, the three AI giants—Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk—have each urged a slowdown in AI development. In response, Wistron (3231-TW) Chairman Lin Hsien-Ming and Pegatron (4938-TW) Chairman Tong Tzu-Hsian both said today (the 18th) that they remain optimistic about the AI sector.

Lin Hsien-Ming said that, based on current observations, Wistron’s own orders have not changed, overall demand remains robust, and capacity is still operating at a high level, so he stays positive about the AI industry's outlook.

However, Lin also noted that beyond the AI giants’ joint call to slow development, one must watch the opposition from local U.S. communities to building data centers, especially as the United States heads into its midterm elections, which could turn the issue into a political vote‑seeking topic.

Lin further explained that when companies face industry or demand shifts and need to adjust strategy, they must balance acceleration with braking—such as incorporating risk considerations into capital‑expenditure planning and preparing financing and operational structures in advance so they can weather a storm when it arrives.

He emphasized that encountering difficulties is inevitable in industry development—whether technical, social, or environmental—but believes these challenges can be resolved one by one, maintaining a hopeful view of the sector.

Tong Tzu-Hsian pointed out that the AI giants recently called for a slowdown due to safety concerns, but he likened it to “three sports cars wanting to race,” suggesting each is trying to gain a competitive edge while simultaneously calling for brakes. Overall, Tong remains very bullish on AI, believing the technology can still balance safety and efficiency in the future.

paras: 一、盤勢結構：強勢長紅突破，量價同步轉強

台股今日呈現「開高震盪走高」格局，終場大漲892.75點、收47,180.75點，成交值放大至約1.075兆元，重新站回47K整數關卡，且指數突破10日線與月線，短線技術面明顯轉強。
OTC櫃買指數同步強彈，顯示多方並非僅集中於大型權值股，中小型電子與AI題材股亦出現資金回流。
籌碼面明顯改善，外資買超869.94億元、投信52.89億元、自營商243.03億元，三大法人合計買超逾1,165億元；其中外資單日買超金額更居歷史前段班。
因此，短線觀察重點已由「防守」逐步轉向「反彈能否延續、量能能否有效承接」，後續若指數震盪，只要主要均線與前波支撐未明顯失守，仍可視為高檔換手與籌碼整理。


二、Fed因素：升息落地，市場進入重新定價階段

Fed於9/16宣布升息1碼，聯邦基金利率目標區間升至3.75%～4.00%，符合市場預期；官方同時表示經濟活動維持穩健，但通膨仍偏高。
Fed最新預測顯示，2026年GDP成長率中位數為2.3%、2027年2.4%，經濟並未出現急劇降溫訊號。
不過政策路徑仍具不確定性，Fed官員預測2026年底利率仍可能再升一次，因此油價、通膨與利率仍是短線市場波動的重要變數。
對台股而言，升息結果落地後，市場焦點可望重新回到企業獲利、AI資本支出與基本面，但仍不宜忽略利率與地緣政治風險。


三、基本面：AI需求持續，出口創高提供支撐

台灣8月出口達824億美元、年增41%，創單月歷史新高，並連續第34個月正成長，主要受AI、HPC、雲端應用與電子零組件需求推動。
AI資料中心持續擴建，使半導體、伺服器、先進封裝、高速傳輸及散熱等供應鏈仍具營收能見度。
因此，台股目前的核心支撐仍來自「AI需求＋出口成長＋企業獲利」，短線指數雖有高檔震盪可能，但基本面主軸尚未改變。


四、產業主軸：AI供應鏈仍是市場核心

產業布局可持續聚焦ASIC、先進封裝、CPO／矽光子、高速傳輸、散熱、測試設備、半導體材料與廠務工程等方向。
台積電(2330-TW)近期指出，矽光子正成為光收發器主流架構，預估2027年市占率可望超過50%，且CPO已有廠商於今年下半年進入量產，顯示光通訊與AI資料中心高速傳輸需求正在加速。
AI產業競爭焦點也逐漸由單純「技術競爭」轉向產能、封裝、光通訊與供應鏈整合能力，因此具備實際訂單及產能擴張能力的公司值得持續追蹤。


五、選股策略：選股重於選市，低接不追高

短線操作仍以「強勢主流＋基本面成長＋籌碼改善」為主要篩選條件。
可留意ASIC、CPO／矽光子、AI高速傳輸、散熱、先進封裝、測試、半導體設備及材料等族群。
今日強勢股大致集中於上述AI主流題材，若後續出現量縮拉回、但主要均線與支撐仍守穩，可觀察是否形成第二波攻擊契機。

整體而言，今日行情屬於「升息落地＋法人回補＋AI基本面支撐」共同推動的強勢反彈。後續真正值得觀察的，不是單日漲幅能否延續，而是47K之上能否建立新的量價平衡，以及外資回補能否持續；若量價與法人籌碼同步維持正向，市場焦點仍有機會回到AI供應鏈與個股基本面，操作上則以「選股重於選市、低接不追高」為核心。

paras: 台股大漲近900點，真正值得注意的，不只是指數重新站上47,000點，而是盤面的結構正在改變。上市、櫃買同步走強，上漲家數明顯擴大，期貨也重新出現正價差，市場風險偏好正在回升。更重要的是，聯準會升息這個壓在市場心上的不確定因素終於落地。過去大家擔心升息、非農、CPI，每一次數據公布前都不敢進場，但當市場已經知道升息就是既定方向，資金反而會重新把焦點放回企業獲利與產業基本面。對我來說，47,000點不是重點，真正的問題是：接下來資金會往哪裡走，下一棒又會由誰接棒？

從總體環境來看，現在的條件也比先前更有利。美國貨幣政策的不確定性降低，而台灣央行選擇維持利率不動，在出口、半導體與電子產業仍具成長動能之下，經濟基本面並沒有因為升息循環而明顯轉弱。接下來更重要的時間點會落在10月中旬，美國科技巨頭陸續公布財報；如果企業獲利與展望依舊維持成長，市場將重新確認AI與科技產業的基本面。再往後，第三季財報、法說會、年底作帳以及明年的作夢行情也會陸續接棒，因此第四季很可能不是單一事件行情，而是一波又一波基本面利多重新點火的過程。

操作上也必須把長線與波段分開。長線股票看的是基本面與產業趨勢，持有週期可以拉長到三至六個月，透過分批布局降低追高風險；波段操作則應偏向右側交易，等待突破、關鍵K或止跌訊號確認後再進場，持有時間以一至三個月為主。像近期中砂、京元電子、精測，以及記憶體族群中的群聯、華邦電，都反映一件事：行情真正啟動前，最重要的不是每天猜高點低點，而是先把產業研究、選股條件與進出場SOP準備好。市場震盪時，好的股票可能暫時套牢；但行情來的時候，真正拉開績效差距的，往往就是你有沒有提前站在對的產業與資金方向上。

paras: 2026愛知·名古屋亞洲運動會即將盛大登場！台新新光金控長期深耕臺灣體育發展，旗下贊助選手共有13位取得亞運參賽資格，包括：高爾夫球錢珮芸、霹靂舞許馥雅、籃球雷蒙恩、電競劉祥、胡新睿、秦詠期、郭頤碩、陳益田、劉庭偉及空手道辜翠萍、石政中、田欣兒、洪芷暄等涵蓋5大運動項目，他們將披上國家隊戰袍出征，迎戰亞洲各國頂尖好手，展現多年刻苦扎根的訓練成果。
台新新光金控針對本次取得亞運國手資格的贊助選手，率先提撥合計近百萬元的「入選嘉勉金」，獎勵選手歷經嚴格選拔、脫穎而出的堅毅付出；如選手於正式賽事中成功奪牌，將依成績頒發優渥獎金，總獎勵金額最高近新台幣800萬元。台新新光金控期盼成為選手最堅強的後盾，讓健兒們全心專注備戰、在賽場上全力爭取榮耀。
台新新光金控表示，運動員的卓越成就來自日以繼夜的苦練與每一次的自我突破。企業對於體育的支持，並不是僅聚焦在賽事的獎牌結果，因此，台新新光金控對本次亞運特別採取「入選即嘉勉、奪牌再獎勵」的雙軌機制，選手取得代表權就是一種榮耀，從那一刻起就給予肯定與支持。這樣的做法可以讓培力與激勵緊密串聯，建立更完善且長遠的運動培育體系。
為深化推動「運動培力計畫」，台新新光金控整合集團體育資源，除了原有的高爾夫、空手道及籃球等贊助項目外，亦積極拓展至霹靂舞、跆拳道與電競等新興運動；同時，藉由舉辦「小小培力營」向下扎根基層教育，串聯起頂尖競技、青年人才培育與基層運動推廣的三維體系。迎接本次名古屋亞運，台新新光金控全力為所贊助的13位國手加油打氣，期盼健兒們能淋漓盡致的展現實力、突破自我。

台新新光金控秉持「認真、創新、永續」的企業精神，持續投入多元領域的體育推廣，長期支持職籃臺北台新戰神、職棒味全龍，以及台新新光金控女子路跑等大型賽事；更連續20年不間斷支持南投空手道隊，孕育出谷筱霜、辜翠萍等亞運金牌名將。今年擴大贊助霹靂舞國手許馥雅與跆拳道奧運銅牌得主羅嘉翎，構建更完整、多元的體育人才培育版圖。除了扶植菁英競技，更進一步推動運動向下扎根計畫，藉由「小小培力營」與偏鄉校園推廣，邀請受贊助選手親自擔任示範與指導教練，以實際行動陪伴孩子在運動中發掘潛能、建立自信，積極朝「從菁英培育走向全民扎根」的永續體育願景邁進。
paras_en: The 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games are about to kick off! Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding has long been dedicated to the development of sports in Taiwan. Its sponsored athletes include 13 who have qualified for the Asian Games: golfer Qian Peiyun, breakdancer Xu Fuya, basketball player Raymond En, e‑sports players Liu Xiang, Hu Xinrui, Qin Yongqi, Guo Yishuo, Chen Yitian, Liu Tingwei, as well as karatekas Gu Cui‑ping, Shi Zhengzhong, Tian Xiner and Hong Zhixuan, covering five major sports. They will don the national team uniform and compete against top athletes from across Asia, showcasing years of hard‑earned training results.

Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding has earmarked nearly NT$10 million in "Selection Commendation" awards for the athletes who earned Asian Games national team spots, recognizing their rigorous selection and perseverance. Should any athlete win a medal in the official competition, a generous prize will be granted, with total possible rewards reaching up to almost NT$8 million. The group hopes to be the athletes’ strongest backing, allowing them to focus fully on preparation and pursue glory on the field.

The company said athletes’ outstanding achievements stem from relentless practice and continual self‑breakthroughs. Corporate support for sports is not limited to medal outcomes; therefore Taishin Shin Kong adopts a dual‑track mechanism for this Asian Games: “commendation upon selection, additional reward upon medalling.” Earning the right to represent the nation is itself an honor that merits immediate recognition and support. This approach links empowerment with motivation, building a more comprehensive and long‑term athlete development system.

To deepen its "Sports Empowerment Program," Taishin Shin Kong consolidates group sports resources, expanding beyond its existing sponsorships in golf, karate and basketball to include emerging disciplines such as breakdancing, taekwondo and e‑sports. It also runs a "Little Empowerment Camp" to root sports education at the grassroots level, linking elite competition, youth talent cultivation and community sports promotion. Ahead of the Nagoya Asian Games, the group is cheering on its 13 sponsored national athletes, hoping they will fully display their abilities and push beyond their limits.

Taishin Shin Kong upholds the corporate spirit of "seriousness, innovation, sustainability," continuously investing in diverse sports promotion. It has long supported the professional basketball team Taipei Taishin Warriors, the professional baseball team Wei‑Chuan Dragons, and the Taishin Shin Kong Women’s Road Run, among other major events. For 20 consecutive years it has backed the Nantou karate team, producing Asian Games gold‑medalists such as Gu Xiaoshuang and Gu Cui‑ping. This year it expanded sponsorship to breakdancer Xu Fuya and Olympic taekwondo bronze‑medalist Luo Jialing, creating a more complete, diversified talent‑development map. Beyond elite support, the group advances grassroots initiatives through the "Little Empowerment Camp" and rural school outreach, inviting sponsored athletes to serve as demonstrators and coaches, helping children discover potential, build confidence, and move toward the sustainable vision of "from elite cultivation to nationwide rooting."
